hypothesis_1.description: Geometry-backed part (Part2DGeomFrom2DMesh) must replace orphan instance in rootAssembly
hypothesis_1.details: F20 and F21 left rootAssembly referencing orphan mesh instance PART-1-1. Replacing the assembly instance with the geometry part is necessary for assembly to expose geometry faces, but cannot be proven without Abaqus CAE execution.

hypothesis_2.description: RemeshingRule region must be assigned to specific geometry Face/Cell region or Set, not symbolic MODEL
hypothesis_2.details: Symbolic MODEL on an imported orphan mesh model failed. Assigning region=instance.faces or part.faces may be required by Abaqus remeshing engines.

hypothesis_3.description: An AdaptivityProcess object must be registered in mdb.adaptivityProcesses
hypothesis_3.details: AdaptivityProcess requires maxIterations >= 2, which could trigger multi-iteration solver loops.

hypothesis_4.details: F21 proved that RemeshingRule alone with region=MODEL raises AbaqusException when calling model.adaptiveRemesh(odb).

conclusion: More than one plausible association remains and no positive offline proof exists under Abaqus 2023. Selecting an API route by guessing without CAE execution is prohibited.
